headline: Clean: the customer pays a $75 balance from checking, then accepts a one-year annual-fee waiver offered because she has been a customer for 3 years.
solution_check: Following logistics_003 Step 1 (dispute history via general_016, pending replacements via replacements_005, age, balance) finds a $75.00 balance on cc_224959b99e_plat. Account '05' (checking, $2,850) pays it via logistics_009. Step 2 history is empty, Step 3 logs annual_fee, and Step 4 tenure (opened 11/10/2022, 3 years) gives annual_fee_waived until 11/14/2026 with reason loyalty_benefit. This matches gold exactly, and the gold replay runs without errors.
prior_note: The prior review found it clean; the task and docs are unchanged and it is still clean.
notes: Grading-model facts confirmed against snapshot: EnvironmentEvaluator replays gold on a fresh env and requires equal agent+user DB hashes (in this domain both toolkits share one TransactionalDB, so the two hashes are identical); _derive_read_log_allowlist logs discoverable READ calls only when gold calls them, but discoverable WRITE calls are logged by tool name even when the tool returns an error string; numbers in call_discoverable_agent_tool/call_discoverable_user_tool are parsed with parse_int=float; get_now() = 2025-11-14 03:40:00. unlock_discoverable_agent_tool is in-memory only and never hashed.
